Join One of Dubai's Flagship Community Healthcare Clinics
HealthHub Clinics, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Registered Nurse to join our multidisciplinary team at HealthHub Dubai Festival City.

Located in the heart of Dubai Festival City, one of Dubai's premier residential, retail, and lifestyle destinations, HealthHub serves a diverse community of families, professionals, corporate clients, and residents.

The clinic offers a comprehensive range of healthcare services including Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Women's Health, Specialist Care, Laboratory Services, Diagnostic Imaging, and Preventive Health Programs.
We are specifically seeking a Tagalog-speaking Registered Nurse who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and enjoys working within a busy outpatient healthcare environment.
This role is ideal for candidates looking for a stable 5-day working week, a supportive clinical environment, and long-term career growth within one of the UAE's leading healthcare providers.
As a Registered Nurse, you will play a vital role in supporting physicians and patients across multiple specialties while delivering safe, effective, and compassionate nursing care.

You will be responsible for patient assessments, clinical procedures, medication administration, health education, and supporting the day-to-day delivery of high-quality outpatient healthcare services.
